SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Taipei as her world knows it — a capital of a southern island myth-world in a steaming volcanic basin: pale bamboo and dark volcanic stone, carved dark wood and woven rattan, jade-green glass, paper lanterns and drifting spirit lights, curls of warm spring steam and tea blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the great tower, the volcanic mountains or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a clear spring glowing with soft blue light in a mossy grotto, tiny spirit creatures of light hovering over the water
Season: the plum-rain season — from May into June, long spells of soft, warm rain under low grey skies.
Weather: a plum-rain day — soft, steady warm rain, wet streets shining and the hills lost in grey cloud.
Time of day: past midnight — the last lamps still burning and the streets nearly empty; warm pools of lamplight, soft shadow beyond.
Hair: her hair twisted up at the back of her head and held with a simple hairpin or clip, a few strands loose — same colour and length as the attached image.
Outfit: a draped satin bustier gathered into a large knot at the bust over matching briefs — in clean neutrals such as white, ivory, oatmeal or soft grey; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with worn slipping down off one shoulder and delicate drop earrings, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips, her back gently arched and her shoulders lowered toward the viewer, as if leaning in close.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body facing the camera; head facing the camera straight on, both ears about equally visible; camera at her eye level; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: slightly furrowed brow, softened eyes, lips lightly pressed together.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a slender wand of pale yellowish-white spring crystal glowing faintly from within — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, sunglasses, bucket hat, beanie, sun visor, acetate.
